_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 8 OF 10: THE GAS LEAK.

THE HOOK (10-28): the radio is the technician who has to go back in after you. Rewritten 2026-10-28 on his bar, "just about making each mission feel interesting in some way" (and "go ahead on the 7"): the draft had nothing in it worth mentioning afterwards.
Something is leaking, and three vents need closing from their own controls before anyone can work there again. Close
them in any order. The verb is SEAL, and it ends on the third vent rather than a fight, so the site's own occupants
are the danger, not a set piece.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

broadcast: I'm the one who has to go back in there and find out what started this, so I'd like it to stop leaking first. Three vents, all open, each one closes from its own control, and breathe as little as you can while you're in there.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
recap: The <Place> was venting from three places at once. I closed all three, and the site can be worked again.
recapSay: Readings are coming down everywhere. I'll be in tomorrow with a mask to find out what started it.
